thread:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout v2026-03-21b -> prod. Plan: 0% -> 5% -> 25% every 10m. rollout_id=r-9624

sara-ops: copying ops. I'll be on standby for stop/go. change window OK until 22:00 PST.

lina: quick heads-up — small error spike in ap-east-1 on /v1/chat (non-stream). Not present in us-west or eu-west. Recommend pausing at 5% and triage before advancing.

kmurphy: what's the volume and error class? user-facing?

lina: ~0.9% 502s on ap-east-1, primarily on longer-context requests (>4k tokens). Logs show kvcache evictions and occasional worker OOMs. Snippet:
```
2026-03-21T18:04:12Z worker-07 kvcache: evict attempt failed: mem-alloc error
2026-03-21T18:04:12Z worker-07 inference: respond 502 model=v2026-03-21b path=/v1/chat
```

sara-ops: hold at 5% then. @deploy-bot pause rollout and pin traffic at current ratio. We'll decide stop/go after triage.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-9624 paused at 5% by sara-ops. Snapshotting metrics, traces: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/rollouts/r-9624

reza: can we do a region-scoped pin to the previous model rather than full rollback?

lina: yes, routing supports per-region pins. Options: A) pin ap-east to v2026-03-19c, B) shift ap-east traffic to warm nodes, C) reduce non-streaming image/chat workload in region. My recommendation: region pin to previous build while we profile.

kmurphy: +1. Safer to avoid global rollback. @infra, can we apply region pin now?

sara-ops: go ahead. Also add a short blurb to the release notes mentioning the regional pin and follow-up fix.

deploy-bot: Executing: `redwoodctl rollout pin --region ap-east-1 --model v2026-03-19c --rollout r-9624 --reason "ap-east 502"` ... done. ap-east pinned to v2026-03-19c. Overall traffic remains 5%.

kmurphy: monitoring: global 5xx now 0.10% (baseline 0.04%). ap-east pre-pin 0.92% -> post-pin 0.07%. Looks stable for now.

lina: starting memprof and heap traces on affected hosts, will post findings in infra-incident channel. I suspect kvcache path allocations regress with new attention kernel under some hardware.

reza: filed CR to document pin and triage steps: https://cr.redwood/reviews/3340. Assigning to @lina for analysis and to infra for kernel-level checks.

sara-ops: decision: hold rollout at 5% for one warmup cycle (15m). If no further regressions in other regions, we'll resume to 25% but exclude ap-east until fixed. If ap-east errors exceed 0.5% for 10m, escalate and consider global rollback. React with :white_check_mark: once you're watching dashboards.

kmurphy: :white_check_mark:

lina: :white_check_mark: (profiling in progress)

deploy-bot: Rollout r-9624 status: paused at 5%, ap-east pinned to v2026-03-19c. Action items: Lina -> memprof, Reza -> release notes update, Ops -> monitor. Next check-in in 15m.

sara-ops: thanks team. If anyone spots a regression please ping me immediately and we'll convene a stop/go call.
